# SkyUsdsPsm3Ark

## SkyUsdsPsm3Ark
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SkyUsdsPsm3Ark.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SkyUsdsPsm3Ark

Ark that swaps the fleet asset to sUSDS via the Sky PSM3 for yield,
and swaps sUSDS back to the fleet asset on withdrawal


### State Variables
#### psm
The PSM3 contract for fleet asset <-> sUSDS swaps

Uses external oracle for rate, making it manipulation resistant


```solidity
IPSM3 public immutable psm
```


#### susds
The sUSDS token contract


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable susds
```


### Functions
#### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _psm, address _susds, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```

#### totalAssets


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```

#### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

SkyUsdsPsm3Ark is withdrawable if there's enough USDC to swap for


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

#### _board

Swaps the fleet asset to sUSDS via the PSM3


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _disembark

Swaps sUSDS back to the exact requested fleet-asset amount via the PSM3


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _validateBoardData

Validates the board data (no-op; this Ark requires no board data)


```solidity
function _validateBoardData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _validateDisembarkData

Validates the disembark data (no-op; this Ark requires no disembark data)


```solidity
function _validateDisembarkData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _harvest

No-op harvest: yield is auto-compounded inside sUSDS, so no rewards are claimed


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```



## IPSM3
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SkyUsdsPsm3Ark.sol)

**Title:**
IPSM3

Minimal interface for the Sky PSM3 used to swap between the fleet
asset and sUSDS at an oracle-derived rate


### Functions
#### previewSwapExactIn

Previews the output amount for an exact-input swap


```solidity
function previewSwapExactIn(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountIn
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 amountOut);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|Asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|Asset being bought|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|Amount of assetIn|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|Amount of assetOut that would be received|


#### previewSwapExactOut

Previews the input amount required for an exact-output swap


```solidity
function previewSwapExactOut(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountOut
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 amountIn);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|Asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|Asset being bought|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|Desired amount of assetOut|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|Amount of assetIn that would be required|


#### swapExactIn

Swaps an exact input amount, requiring at least minAmountOut out


```solidity
function swapExactIn(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountIn,
    uint256 minAmountOut,
    address receiver,
    uint256 referralCode
)
    external
    returns (uint256 amountOut);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|Asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|Asset being bought|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|Amount of assetIn to sell|
|`minAmountOut`|`uint256`|Minimum acceptable amount of assetOut|
|`receiver`|`address`|Recipient of assetOut|
|`referralCode`|`uint256`|Referral code for the swap|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|Amount of assetOut received|


#### swapExactOut

Swaps for an exact output amount, spending at most maxAmountIn


```solidity
function swapExactOut(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountOut,
    uint256 maxAmountIn,
    address receiver,
    uint256 referralCode
)
    external
    returns (uint256 amountIn);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|Asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|Asset being bought|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|Exact amount of assetOut to receive|
|`maxAmountIn`|`uint256`|Maximum acceptable amount of assetIn to spend|
|`receiver`|`address`|Recipient of assetOut|
|`referralCode`|`uint256`|Referral code for the swap|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|Amount of assetIn spent|
